data.name: Skill Issue
data.detailed_description:
Skill Issue is a collection of competitive minigames where you can outplay the competition through pure mechanical skill-master. Bunny hop through intense minigames, punch your friends into ragdolls, drag their unconscious bodies, and hit them with the ultimate disrespect.

KEY FEATURES

  • Movement Mechanics: Master mechanics such as Airstrafe, B-Hop, Surf and Ladder-Hop

  • Physics-Based Ragdoll Chaos: Every punch carries weight. Connect with a solid hook to send players tumbling into fully simulated ragdoll states.

  • The Ultimate Disrespect: What do you do when you knock someone out? Grab their limp ragdoll body, drag them into hazards and dance over their dead bodies. Emotional damage guaranteed.

  • Brutal Minigames: Survive a rotating gauntlet of chaotic game modes designed to test your reflexes, your movement, and your ability to betray your friends at the perfect moment.

  • Multiplayer Mayhem: Host or join lobbies, talk trash and vote what minigames you would like to play.

Do you have what it takes, or do you just have a Skill Issue?
